title: Celestin takes over the Paddock; his $300 demand
summary: Celestin takes the job from Ridgley, falls ill, demands $300 a week from the Paddock owners, and Bill stays on with Ridgley.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And the next six months Celestine had taken the job over from Ricard. And that threw at Ricard and made everything go to Papa Celestine. You see? Everything was Papa Celestine. So Papa Celestine was sick then. I know he was very sick then. So he worked there a few years and got himself straightened out. And he stopped to fool him around. He didn't want to work anymore, you know. Didn't know how to quit. So finally he jumped down. So Houston, he burst a little to the board. Houston said, what do you want to do? He said, I want to make, I want to get my band in here. So he had another band on our side. Certain men he wanted to get in there to work.
That's Fats, Fats Houston? No, Celestine. Celestine.

Yeah, Papa. So he said, I want to get some other fellas to work with. So he thought he was all tired of it, Mr. Steve Leonard. Mr. Steve Leonard would do anything he said he would do. So Houston said, what do you want a week? So Papa Celestine said, I want $300 a week. That time he was getting $70. He said, I want $300 a week for myself. So I told him, I said, well, Papa, you know, you don't want to work there. He said, well, you're right, Billy. You're right. I don't want to work there. He said, if you give me $300 a week, I'll work. And I'll work with my other band. He said, what do you intend to do? I said, I'm going to stick on the job where I'm working at. I'm working with Ricard. Ricard Broaddus here. And I'm working and making a great improvement in it.

He said, you get on out there and make another band of yourself. That's all you can do. Be okay with me. Anytime I happen to need you, I'll ask you for a job. That's all I can do. Until now. Pop me up in a little band until now. I'm still at the paddock.
Yeah. All right. So much out.
